exposure: duration of neonatal intensive care unit stay
cohort: 8,517 very low birth weight (VLBW) preterm infants
finding: Multiple perinatal risk factors including low birth weight, periventricular/intraventricular hemorrhage, and emergency cesarean delivery are associated with poor MDI and PDI scores among VLBW preterm infants.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery was associated with adverse PDI scores in VLBW infants.
